north_two_00_00.scope: Post hoc cross-identification by exact unique SDSS physical members plus shared NSC training members. The original year was excluded before training reconstruction. Full-period class uses all data and is a retrospective condition. The independent candidate, footprint and displaced-position denominators remain in the blind-year archive. This comparison is not an unconditional star-purity estimate.
